commitment_constraints_open.fail: Commitment of {crew} for the week of {week} is on a task with {count} open constraint(s)
commitment_constraints_open.suggestion: Clear the constraints first, or take the task out of this week's plan

week_ppc_recorded.fail: The week of {week} had commitments but no PPC was recorded
week_ppc_recorded.suggestion: Close the weekly plan so its PPC is computed

missed_commitment_reason.fail: A missed commitment of {crew} in the week of {week} has no reason for variance
missed_commitment_reason.suggestion: Record the reason, so it counts in the Pareto of causes

constraint_overdue.fail: Constraint "{description}" was due to be cleared by {date} and is still open
constraint_overdue.suggestion: Chase the owner, or move the target date and the affected tasks

constraint_owner.suggestion: Name the person responsible for clearing it
